narrative.overview:
watahub.dev is the account panel's world turned into a long reading page. It invents no new identity. The authority for colors, radii, the type stack, the shared primitives (buttons, badges, the secret box, the segmented control, rows, the checklist mark, icons, focus) and the named rules One Teal, Word-and-Icon, Machine Mono, Sentence Case and Overlays-Only is watahub-ee/DESIGN.md (https://github.com/Hub-Ventures/watahub-ee/blob/main/DESIGN.md) with its sidecar watahub-ee/.impeccable/design.json (https://github.com/Hub-Ventures/watahub-ee/blob/main/.impeccable/design.json). This file records only what the public site adds or adapts, measured from site/public/site.css and the six pages.

The site's own idea is that every WhatsApp moment sits beside its machine twin. On the left is what a person sees (a chat well, a checklist, a list). On the right is what the machine gets or sends (the signed delivery, the POST /v1/messages with no Meta token, the connect response). A thin connector joins the two. Display type is larger than the panel's because the page has to persuade, but the density, borders, flatness and the single teal stay at product level. The page is static: no scripts, no inline styles, every asset from 'self'.
keyCharacteristics: Inherits tokens.css and components.css verbatim from watahub-ee; site.css is the only stylesheet authored here.
A display ramp the panel lacks (h1 up to 56px) over a 15px body, in a 1200px column.
The hero h1 is the tagline alone, followed by the lede and three numbered steps in neutral circles.
Message/record pairs as the recurring form: chat well on bg, record on surface, connector between.
One authored motion: the hero connectors draw in once on load, cut by reduced motion.
Every demo frame and sample value is labelled "Example data" in the page's language.
Three languages with identical markup; light and dark follow the OS through the inherited light-dark() tokens.

rules.name: The Lit Pair Rule
rules.body: Teal appears on a connector or a code-well border only while its pair is hovered or focused. At rest connectors are border-strong and code wells are borderless surface-2.

rules.name: The Display Exception Rule
rules.body: Display sizes and the -0.02em tracking exist only on the h1 and the two oversized headings above; everything else stays on the inherited panel scale. Sentence Case still holds: no uppercase, no tracked labels.

rules.name: The Same Markup Rule
rules.body: A structural change lands in all three languages in the same change; the pages differ only in text and language metadata.

rules.name: The Static Page Rule
rules.body: If it needs a script, an inline style or a third-party origin, it does not ship on watahub.dev.

dos: Do take every color, radius and type token from the mirrored tokens.css, and change them in watahub-ee, never here.
Do put each human moment beside its machine record, joined by a connector, on bg and surface respectively.
Do label every demo frame and every sample secret with an "Example data" badge in the page's language.
Do keep code wells surface-2 on every viewport and set every ID, path, method, header and key in mono.
Do reuse the hero step titles verbatim as the h2s of their sections, in every language.
Do keep the hero tight enough that the next section's heading shows at 1440×800.
Do land structural changes in /, /es/ and /pt/ together.
Do keep the one connector draw as the page's only animation, and leave reduced motion to the inherited rule.
donts: Don't edit site/public/tokens.css or site/public/components.css; copy them again from watahub-ee.
Don't add scripts, inline styles, CDN fonts or third-party images; the CSP forbids them.
Don't split the values or kinds into separate cards, or nest a framed list inside a pair's frame.
Don't put a teal wash or a teal border at rest inside a code well.
Don't use display sizes or -0.02em tracking below the h1 and the two oversized headings.
Don't show a sample key, ID or conversation without its "Example data" badge.
Don't number a list unless its order carries meaning, and don't color step numbers teal.
